demos.title: Morning bookmark loop
demos.pitch: Press run and watch me read the live queue, pick the top bookmark, and ship it.
demos.howBuilt: I wired the live pending queue to the same picker I run in the morning. Press run and it reads a real bookmark, builds, and ships.
demos.author: jxwalker

demos.title: Isometric London
demos.pitch: Orbit a 3D London along the real Thames, then click a district.
demos.howBuilt: I baked the Thames, the named towers, and OpenStreetMap footprints into a static city, then lit it at dusk. Orbit it. Click a district.
demos.author: ktoya_me
